title: Company Q2 Report: Engineering, Marketing, and Finance
content:
Company Q2 Report: Engineering, Marketing, and Finance

Engineering Department Update

The engineering team completed the migration from monolith to microservices architecture. Total of 12 services were deployed to Kubernetes cluster with 99.9% uptime SLA.

The CI/CD pipeline was upgraded to use GitHub Actions, reducing build times from 45 minutes to 12 minutes. Code coverage increased from 72% to 89% across all repositories.

Three critical security vulnerabilities were patched: CVE-2024-1234, CVE-2024-5678, and CVE-2024-9012. All patches were deployed within 24 hours of disclosure.

Marketing Department Update

The marketing team launched the new brand identity campaign across social media platforms. Instagram followers grew by 340% and Twitter engagement increased by 215%.

The content marketing strategy shifted to focus on video tutorials and webinars. Average webinar attendance was 850 participants, up from 200 in Q1.

Partnership with TechConf 2024 was finalized, securing a platinum sponsor slot and 3 speaking opportunities for company executives.

Finance Department Update

Total revenue for Q2 was $4.2 million, representing a 28% increase over Q1. Operating expenses were $2.8 million, with a net profit margin of 33%.

The finance team completed the annual audit with no material findings. New expense tracking system reduced reimbursement processing time by 60%.

Series B fundraising preparations are underway. Target raise is $15 million at a $120 million pre-money valuation. Three VC firms are in due diligence.
